rv.q: The chemistry between the four leads is apparent from the balcony in the way back, and they are the cherry on top of the best touring production that I’ve reviewed at TPAC so far this year.
This 20th anniversary tour brought the Four Seasons back with just as much talent and style as ever!
If you want to see the standard that all jukebox musicals should live up to, this is the the category-defining show.
It's a polished, energetic reminder of why the story of four Jersey guys who sang their way from the streets of New Jersey to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame has endured for two decades.
The musical still rocks, as it’s brought vividly to life in this non-Equity tour.

If I set aside my personal nostalgia for The Four Seasons music and those days of oldie stations and pirated music, a fog lifts, and I’m objectively seeing a musical that feels dated, lacking, and not all that compelling a story.
Jersey Boys has it all: real-life complications and phenomenally engaging entertainment.

cn.t: The 20th anniversary tour proves this jukebox musical still captivates audiences with its effective storytelling and beloved Four Seasons hits, drawing enthusiastic crowds who can't help but bop along.
